meta.name: Ruin Explorers
meta.description:
Fam and Ihrie are ruin explorers, scraping out a living by digging relics from the ruins of a lost age when magic ruled the world. Ihrie is a formidable sorceress with a catch: a curse turns her into a small furry creature every time she casts a spell. Breaking it means finding the Ultimate Power, sealed behind three relics — and they're not the only ones hunting it. Rival treasure hunters, a prince whose kingdom was destroyed, and the dark sorcerer Ruguduroll are all after the same prize, in a comic fantasy adventure.

meta.description:

Haiji persuades Kakeru to live in the old apartment "Chikuseisou" where he plans to team up with fellow residents to enter Hakone Ekiden Marathon, one of the most prominent university races in Japan. Kakeru soon finds out that all of the residents except for Haiji and himself are complete novices.

meta.name: Rurouni Kenshin
meta.description:
Ten years have passed since the end of Bakumatsu, an era of war that saw the uprising of citizens against the Tokugawa shogunate. The revolutionaries wanted to create a time of peace, and a thriving country free from oppression. The new age of Meiji has come, but peace has not yet been achieved. Swords are banned but people are still murdered in the streets. Orphans of war veterans are left with nowhere to go, while the government seems content to just line their pockets with money.
